newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan court delays verdict on British women.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan court delays verdict on British women.

text.p: A Moroccan court on Thursday delayed for one week its judgment on an appeal by two British women against five-year jail terms for drug smuggling.
A court spokesman said: "The court will give its verdict on October 17."
Hairdresser Sally Louise Griffiths and barmaid Claire Louise Martin, aged respectively 18 and 28, from Harwich southeast England, were jailed last August.
They were charged with possessing and trading five kg (11 lbs) of cannabis resin, and were also each fined 5,000 dirhams ($581).

Police said earlier the two Britons were promised 1,500 sterling ($2,325) by a British drug dealer in Amsterdam to carry the cannabis out of Morocco. The two denied the charge or any knowledge of the drug being in their luggage.
